title: The hint after a comment turn's last block is never read as the customer's lasting wish
steps: S1: build one-comment and two-comment turns with the chat input's own builder, words with no lasting wish.
S2: the same with a comment that states one ("From now on …").
expect: S1: only the person's words are left; mayHoldWish is false; a line of the hint never passes quoteIsSaid.
evidence: Issue #256: every Browser-tab comment turn got the wish notice and a site-notes side call, from "never" in Tracy's own hint

tests: the hint after a comment turn’s last block is Tracy’s, not the customer’s: no wish, no quote (#256)
